subject: Help with warning message from calculateDiffMeth function

messages.author: 67571e909b2d8a9a
messages.subject: Help with warning message from calculateDiffMeth function
parts:
Hi,

Could I please get some advice on the following? I analyzed a set of predefined regions as differentially methylated regions using the following steps in sequential order:

obj.filtered = filterByCoverage(obj, lo.count = 10, lo.perc = NULL, hi.count = NULL, hi.perc = NULL)
obj.filtered.norm = normalizeCoverage(obj.filtered)
data = read.table('/path/to/bed.file', header = FALSE)
colnames(data) = c('chr','start','end')
bed = with(data,GRanges(chr, IRanges (start,end)) )
targets= regionCounts(obj.filtered.norm , bed)

#methylation detection for DMC analysis
obj.meth_bases = unite(obj.filtered.norm)
obj.mydiff_bases = calculateDiffMeth(obj.meth_bases)
obj.mydiff_bases_20p = get.methylDiff(obj.mydiff_bases, difference = 20, qvalue = 0.05)


#methylation detection for DMR analysis
obj.meth_targets = unite(targets)
obj.mydiff_targets = calculateDiffMeth(obj.meth_targets)
obj.mydiff_targets_20p = get.methylDiff(obj.mydiff_targets, difference = 20, qvalue = 0.05)


At this last step, the following warning was raised:

Warning message:
glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred 

This warning was not present in the DMC analysis (steps taken are shown above). Some of the DMRs had p and q values of 0. When I merged my DMC file with the DMR file, a number of DMRs had no overlapping DMCs. I then extracted the percentage methylation of individual samples using (percMethylation()) for the DMR regions that did not have an overlapping DMC and observed that there were little or no difference between controls and treated group. As such, I am currently unsure why those regions were considered differentially methylated and how a methylation difference value was assigned to the DMR. Attached is an example.

Could I please be advised on how I might be able to resolve this issue?

Thanks.
